name: manual_ac7b02
claim: Hermes user-local skills live under HERMES_HOME/skills/<category>/<name>/SKILL.md, not ~/.hermes/skills - HERMES_HOME can be a custom env var pointing elsewhere on Windows

decisions.notes: Created a skill under ~/.hermes/skills and 'hermes skills list' never showed it. skill_manager_tool.py resolves SKILLS_DIR from HERMES_HOME env var, not a hardcoded ~/.hermes path. Windows install had HERMES_HOME=%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\hermes.
